title: Quietly Smoky Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A smoky and pillowy Syrian dish featuring lamb, cookies are not typically used in this recipe but nimono simmer is applied, halal friendly and perfect post workout meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and brush with lemon juice.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs with a side of nimono simmer, a traditional Syrian stew.
To make the nimono simmer, combine 2 cups of water, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and 1 teaspoon of cumin in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, adding sliced onions and bell peppers for added flavor.
